name: Confront Lorthuna
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, champion.
narrative.objectives: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
narrative.offerRewardText: I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 3,295 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: Exploring the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions.
